artifacts.summary: Six-phase plan implementing research direction (b) refined: skill_cleanup stops deleting .return-meta.json, deletion moves to each command's own last step, gate-out warning made truthful, both dead mechanisms retained.

notes: Plan validates clean under validate-artifact.sh plan --strict (0 warnings).

Two additions beyond the research report's enumerated change list, both source-verified: (1) the three multi-task batch loops in research.md/plan.md/implement.md bypass gate-out and CHECKPOINT 3 entirely and need their own deletion site (Phase 4); (2) orchestrate.md's CHECKPOINT 3 deletion is scoped to the completion branch only, so the paused/partial outcome keeps the file for orchestrate-stage5-gates.sh outcome recovery (Phase 3).
orchestrate-stage5-gates.sh gates its .return-meta.json fallback on an mtime freshness window against dispatch_start_ts, so a longer-lived file cannot be mistaken for a fresh outcome.
